title: Frog and Toffee
subtitle: Pebbles, frogs, the attic with stinky socks... They're just a teeny tiny part of the whole world.

trails.title: Trail ① "Timetable"
trails.description: A record of a day in Laplace Rehabilitation Center.

content.text:
07:30 a.m. - 08:30 a.m.
Patrolled the lobby and the surrounding areas.

08:30 a.m. - 09:30 a.m.
Reported for duty at the reception, and received 1 visitor.
Reciting the whole employee number? Can anyone actually do that?

09:30 a.m. - 09:35 a.m.
Done with breakfast. P.S. the nut scone today was a bit hard.

09:35 a.m. - 12:30 p.m.
Reception time. Smile, Sandy, smile.

12:30 p.m. - 01:30 p.m.
Lunch time. Roast spinach with potato and roast pork chop.

01:30 p.m. - 02:00 p.m.
Reception time. Never had a pork chop this small!

02:00 p.m. - 03:00 p.m.
Reception time. Where on earth is the 12th issue of Weird Tales? Who would steal a stupid pulp magazine?! Damn it ... Somebody tell me the ending!

03:00 p.m. - 03:05 p.m.
Reception time. Phew, smile, Sandy, smile ...

03:05 p.m. - 04:05 p.m.
Reception time. There seems to be uproar in other areas ...
Ugh ... I think I need to go to the bathroom.

04:05 p.m. - 04:10 p.m.
Reception time. Okay ... Hmm? That was just 5 minutes? Seriously?

04:10 p.m. - 05:30 p.m.
Reception time. Amanda should have reported for duty much earlier.
She was late for unbelievably 45 minutes last time!

05:30 p.m. - 06:30 p.m.
Reception time. Great, she's late ... LATE!
For how much longer do I have to sit in this dump today?!

06:30 p.m. - 07:00 p.m.
Take a deep breath, Sandy, and smile ... Only 30 minutes to go ...

07:3000 pmm - 13312
App**&^le ... Hea*&lthy way to dri@#&*nk every&&hour ...

...

08:00 p.m. - 09:00 p.m.
Help, deal with, the, f**cking emergency!
Somebody please lock those lunatics!! They are running towards the corridor!


Request for Leave: Sandy
Time: 2   3 days
Reason: Mental trauma!!!

trails.title: Trail ② Another Dream Ⅱ
trails.description: A touch of fresh green. The round eye is blinking alone. You can hear the sounds it makes everywhere.

content.text:
The petite ones that are good at jumping often hang around lakes or groves.
They can always make it to under the leaves before the rain drops.
That is how the students who paid attention at class locate where they are,
And catch them with their own hands.

items.text: Frog and Toffee
The last class is over.
Students leave the classroom with their friends in groups.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Goodbye, Miss.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... I will just take another route.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Come here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is my book wall still there? She didn't push it down, right?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She didn't.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Phew ... she is nice. Unlike the bad potion instructor who turned my books into a puddle of mud ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, right! Guess what I found today?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Here, give me your hand.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Look, the foreteller of the rain—the Hyla arborea!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I caught it through the school's front gate. I even got stung by the electric fence when I took my hands back.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It keeps croaking in my pocket! Look, it's still raining outside.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Aren't you aware that you've been given a time-out, Ms. Vertin?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I don't understand ... why you always skip classes.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You know that we are not supposed to pay too much attention to affairs outside the school. Please ... don't bring me these pebbles and frogs anymore.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: These are ... meaningless.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... We are born to die martyrs.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Why? Just because the Student Handbook says so?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That's right.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I don't like the handbook. It smells like those stinky socks in the attic.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto, aren't you really curious about what is outside the school?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You were also in that parade outside the school before ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The pebbles, the frogs, the attic with stinky socks ... They're just a teeny tiny part of the whole world. I once met a girl who came to our school ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Pl-please stop.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: These are very dangerous things.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The Student Handbook is protecting us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It is protecting us from harm and regrets.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As the instructors have told us, to live is to lose things around us until the day we lose life itself to death. That's why we should only focus on the supreme missions.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Until the day we lose life itself ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: To death?
*tut* Failed.
Laplace Rehabilitation Center
Her traumatic segment has been reactivated. Increase the power, stabilize her psychube.
Try the next dream.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: The artificial somnambulism therapy may not work on her, Mesmer.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Hm? You're here, Madam Z.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: All patients who have the symptoms of stress disorder need to receive treatments in the rehabilitation center. Her trauma level was assessed as Type II. I needed to take responsibility for her health.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Back in the year when she became the Timekeeper ... she didn't receive any treatment. I know her well. She has enough power in her to make it through.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I'm just following orders, madam.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: It's the committee's direct order to treat Vertin.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: If you have anything to say, convince the vice president first.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: She hasn't had any food for days. Give her a glucose injection. I have a meeting later, so if you would excuse me.
Madam Z takes her thermos cup and leaves the room.
The ward becomes silent again. There are barely any other sounds except the slight electrical buzzing.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I did expect you would have learned your lesson in such a long time ...

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Timekeeper ... No, I'm more used to calling you Vertin.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: I have changed.

items.speaker: Mesmer Jr.
items.text: Have you? Are you still suffering from those ... pointless things?
She shakes her head; her eyes shift onto the screen.
The psychube amplitude is leaping in a repeated, fixed pattern; Vertin doesn't give her response.
TO BE CONTINUED…
